name: Silent Square Site Ad
description: Silent 1:1 square Facebook / Meta feed ad built entirely in HyperFrames from a brand's OWN live-site assets — no AI media generation, $0 model spend. One timeline with opacity-gated beats (no sub-compositions): topbar + anchor flash, a color-word manifesto filling the upper dead air, a persistent pool of ~12 brand stickers dropped in with a back.out overshoot, article/product cards, a center-pivot pendulum element, and a half-canvas color split that uses the centered logo as the bridge. The discipline that makes it cheap and on-brand: pull the live site's REAL assets first (mask-image SVGs, logos, hero images), read the site's own animation CSS keyframes verbatim instead of guessing physics, pre-rasterize any vector that scales >2x, and snapshot every beat at its hero frame BEFORE rendering. Silent by design (FB feed auto-mutes).
referenceNotes: No AI-gen refs needed. The brand's live site IS the reference — pull its real mask SVGs, logo, hero, and product images, and read its animation CSS.

slots.description: The live site to ground against (asset + CSS source).
Brand HEX tokens, pulled from the site (not from memory).
Brand logo pulled from the site; pre-rasterized to hires PNG if it scales >2x.
Article / product cards to feature (image + title each).
The hero object that swings (cart, bottle, device, ...).
Three pop-color verbs filling the upper dead air.

doNotCopyLiterally: Pull the live site's REAL assets and read its actual animation @keyframes + computed transform-origin BEFORE authoring — do not invent design DNA. Single composition, opacity-gated beats only (no data-composition-src sub-comps). Snapshot every beat at hero frame before rendering. Silent — never gate the message on audio.
stackSummary: No model calls. HyperFrames single composition (opacity-gated beats, GSAP timeline on window.__timelines), Playwright for site-asset + CSS extraction and SVG pre-rasterization, ralphy render for the 1080x1080 mp4. $0 total.
